<jats:title>A<jats:sc>bstract</jats:sc>
                     </jats:title><jats:p>We consider entanglement of first-quantized identical particles by adopting an algebraic approach. In particular, we investigate fermions whose wave functions are given by the Slater determinants, as for singlet sectors of one-matrix models. We show that the upper bounds of the general Rényi entropies are <jats:italic>N</jats:italic> log 2 for <jats:italic>N</jats:italic> particles or an <jats:italic>N × N</jats:italic> matrix. We compute the target space entanglement entropy and the mutual information in a free one-matrix model. We confirm the area law: the single-interval entropy for the ground state scales as <jats:inline-formula><jats:alternatives><jats:tex-math>$$ \frac{1}{3} $$</jats:tex-math><mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                  <mml:mfrac>
                    <mml:mn>1</mml:mn>
                    <mml:mn>3</mml:mn>
                  </mml:mfrac>
                </mml:math></jats:alternatives></jats:inline-formula> log <jats:italic>N</jats:italic> in the large <jats:italic>N</jats:italic> model. We obtain an analytical <jats:inline-formula><jats:alternatives><jats:tex-math>$$ \mathcal{O}\left({N}^0\right) $$</jats:tex-math><mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                  <mml:mi>O</mml:mi>
                  <mml:mfenced>
                    <mml:msup>
                      <mml:mi>N</mml:mi>
                      <mml:mn>0</mml:mn>
                    </mml:msup>
                  </mml:mfenced>
                </mml:math></jats:alternatives></jats:inline-formula> expression of the mutual information for two intervals in the large <jats:italic>N</jats:italic> expansion.</jats:p>
title: Target space entanglement in quantum mechanics of fermions and matrices
